title: Roswell UFO Witness Describes Alien Bodies, Egg-Shaped Craft In Newly Released Files
description: The Pentagon released its seventh batch of newly declassified UFO files including an eyewitness account of the 1947 Roswell suspected UFO crash describing alien bodies and an egg-shaped craft. Building 84, storage site for purported UFO crash debris from the ”1947 Roswell incident,“ remains in use for aviation businesses in Roswell, N.M., on Oct. 7, 2026. John Fredricks/The Epoch Times The tranche of documents also contains a report on the Skinwalker Ranch in Utah with more than two dozen sightings of dog-like creatures, trolls, and other phenomena. The files are part of the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) Encounters, called PURSUE. “These files, hidden behind classifications, have long fueled justified speculation – and it’s time the American people see it for themselves,” Secretary of War Pete Hegseth said in a statement. Among the documents was an affidavit from 2002 believed to be provided by former Roswell Air Base Public Information Officer Walter Haut. In it, Haut describes a staff meeting on July 8, 1947, where officials discussed wreckage collected from a ranch 40 miles from Roswell. “I am convinced that what I personally observed was some type of craft and its crew from outer space,” […]

title: British Airways jet 'nearly crashes' into mystery 'UFO' after leaving Heathrow Airport
description: A British Airways jet has nearly crashed into a mysterious object after leaving Heathrow. The pilot contacted air traffic control after what was described as a shiny silver object, about the "size of four toasters", flew by the plane. The bizarre incident happened at 5,800 feet as over 250 passengers were headed from London to New York. The so-called UFO flew in the opposite direction of the jet. It came "very close" to the right wing, hovering around 50 feet above it, the report added. The near-miss took place on June 24 over Guildford, Surrey. Passengers on the flight safely landed in New York. The UK Airprox Board has now launched an official probe into the incident. It reads: "The B777 pilot reports that they were climbing to altitude 6000ft on departure from LHR. "Passing 5800ft, a shiny silver object passed in the opposite direction, very fast and very close to the right wing of the aircraft at no more than 50ft above aircraft altitude." It added: "The LTCC controller reports that [the pilot of the B777] reported that a drone had just flown over their right wing. "They said it was moving very fast, was probably of silver colour, metallic and reflective. It continued: "In the Board's opinion the reported altitude and/or description of the object were such that they were unable to determine the nature of the unknown object. "The Board considered that providence had played a major part in the incident and/or a definite risk of collision had existed." Just last week it was reported that the RAF had encountered mystery drones during military exercises. The unidentified object was described as a black circle, similar in size to a car tyre. In a separate incident, the drone flew so close a pilot instinctively ducked. Multiple external probes have now been launched to identify the objects.
